obligations.source_text: Create one independent complex fashion photograph that tests whether lace is rendered as visibly attached trim with openwork motifs and scalloped edges rather than as a generic printed texture, while using the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference.

bindings.base_garment_phrase: a smooth base-garment edge remains visibly different from the lace along the satin camisole neckline
bindings.narrow_lace_band_phrase: one narrow lace band follows a neckline cuff or hem edge across the upper chest
bindings.openwork_motifs_phrase: real open cells and repeating thread motifs remain visible in the lace at native detail
bindings.attachment_free_edge_phrase: a stitched attachment line and scalloped free edge remain separately readable along the neckline
bindings.lace_confound_phrase: the material boundary distinguishes attached trim from printed lace and whole-lace fabric at the stitched neckline edge
